$comment: Single source of truth for the App Store listing fields. `npm run check:listing` validates every value against the limits below and fails if the markdown in app-store-listing.md drifts from this file. Limits were checked against Shopify's own documentation and the Partner dashboard field list on 30 Oct 2026 (see docs/LISTING_FACTS.md); they still need one confirmation inside the Partner dashboard before submission, because Shopify can change them without notice.
sources: Partner dashboard listing form: app card subtitle 62, app introduction 100, app details 500, five features of 80, five search terms

fields.name: India Legal Metrology & MRP
fields.subtitle: Check MRP, origin, unit price and prior price rules
fields.introduction: Check listings against India's declaration, e-commerce and prior-price rules.
fields.details: Scan your catalogue against a fixed checklist of Indian product declarations, fix the gaps in bulk, and show MRP, country of origin, unit sale price, the grievance officer and a 30-day prior price on your storefront. Core declarations and the 2020 e-commerce rules apply now. Informational only, not legal advice.
features: Scan every product and variant against India's declaration checklist
Fix gaps in bulk by rule, vendor, product type, or CSV import
Show MRP, origin, net quantity and unit sale price on product pages
Grievance officer block with 48-hour and one-month timings
Prior price from a complete 30-day lookback, suppressed until then
